description: Dziewiata Fala, the ninth wave, the biggest wave of the sea come alive, a towering curling wave of dark blue-green water with a crest of white foam shaped like grasping claws, a fierce face of foam with two glowing pale eyes in the curl, spray flying, an abstract creature of the sea, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the wave alone, no beach, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole wave inside the picture
